node_1.subject: Arthur Burton
node_1.description: Tomas Kessler runs Harvey Oak Supply Store, which was his uncle's. Arthur Burton knows him by sight and by name, and no more.

node_2.subject: Arthur Burton
node_2.description: Sam Moore has had his breakfast at The Rose and Crown Pub most mornings for years. He and Arthur Burton are on easy terms and talk about the town and Sam's navy days.
